title: Punjab activist murder: Bulldozer action begins at property linked to Parvinder Singh Jhota's killer |... - Moneycontrol.com
full_text:
The medical store owner accused of shooting dead anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota in Punjab’s Mansa district has been arrested from Rajasthan.
Meanwhile, a demolition drive was carried out at a property linked to Kumar in Mansa on Wednesday.
Police reached the spot with heavy security deployment as a JCB machine arrived for the action. Mansa SSP Vaibhav Chaudhary was also present during the operation.
The accused, identified as Ashwani Kumar, was taken into custody from Salasar after police launched a search operation following Tuesday’s broad daylight murder.
Jhota was allegedly killed after he confronted Kumar, who ran a medical shop, over the suspected sale of drugs to an elderly man.
The incident was captured during a live Facebook session hosted by Jhota, who was known for campaigning against drug abuse and illegal sale of addictive substances.
After the shooting, Kumar fled from the spot, following which police teams began a manhunt to trace him. On Tuesday, police had also arrested an associate who allegedly helped Kumar escape after the crime.
The murder triggered tension in Mansa, with supporters of Jhota vandalising the medical shop. His family also refused to perform his last rites in protest.
